evidence: Structure shows clear separation of concerns with modules (dply, sql, siu, ops, experimental) representing cohesive responsibilities
Modules interact through well-defined APIs (e.g., siuba imports via __init__.py use explicit imports from submodules)
No external service boundaries or inter-process communication patterns are present
Database backend support (pandas, SQL dialects) is integrated as pluggable components rather than separate services
Test structure mirrors the source structure, indicating monolithic deployment with integrated testing
Shared core components like siu (symbolic execution engine) are reused across dply and sql modules
Config and tooling (setup.py, pytest, CI workflows) are centralized rather than distributed
risks: Potential for tight coupling between modules if interfaces are not carefully maintained
Scaling may require internal refactoring rather than architectural changes
